entries.zh: 主宰：掌管、裁决；西语词头「让出权威」或指交卸权柄
entries.en: to be master of, to rule and decide; (per the Spanish headword) to yield up authority
entries.notes: 「主宰」义为掌权，与 dejar（让出/遗与）方向相反，两存之

entries.zh: 出祖：让出祖业（田产、房业）；「同上条」谓让出权柄
entries.en: to give up ancestral property; (ut supra) to relinquish authority, as in the preceding entry
entries.notes: 「出祖」指让出祖业，与西语「权柄」不合，M 栏第二字音写亦残

entries.zh: 抛舍：抛弃、丢下不管
entries.en: to cast off, to abandon; to leave (it) behind
entries.notes: 第二字 [疑]，据音定为「捨」；西语「mostrar dello」疑抄讹，未据以立义

entries.zh: 放子：任子女自去、放手不管（如母禽弃雏，任其自立）
entries.en: to let one's young go; to forsake the brood and let it shift for itself
entries.notes: 西语「la liebre criar」语义难通，疑为禽兔弃雏/育雏之例证

entries.zh: 避位：让出尊位、退避职任
entries.en: to vacate a seat of honor; to step down from a dignified post

entries.zh: 避邪：远避邪祟、躲开不祥
entries.en: to shun evil; to keep clear of the baleful
entries.notes: 西语 ystacia 损泐难辨（疑 estancia/instancia），释义以汉字「避邪」为据

entries.zh: 撂下手中的活、转往他处
entries.en: to drop what one is doing and go elsewhere
entries.notes: 汉字「棎工郎」疑误（或当作「抛工者」），字栏与音栏不对应，仅据西语定释

entries.zh: 继传：世代相承、把家业遗给后人
entries.en: to hand down an inheritance; to pass property on in succession

entries.zh: 弃官：辞去官职
entries.en: to resign office; to give up a post

entries.zh: 传位：把职位让与继任者
entries.en: to hand over one's office to a successor; to transmit a position

entries.zh: 不根究伊：不追究他、不办其罪
entries.en: not to call him to account; to let him off unpunished

entries.zh: 放纵：任其自便、不加约束
entries.en: to give free rein; to leave (someone) to his own will

entries.zh: 赦下：宽赦释放、免其罪责
entries.en: to pardon and let go; to release (a prisoner)
entries.notes: 「赦下」非常语，疑为「赦放/赦下狱」之记，据西语 soltar 定释

entries.zh: 留名声：留下好名声、扬名于后
entries.en: to leave a name behind; to leave a good repute
entries.notes: 首字 [疑:留/晋]，M、R 两栏音写均合「留」

entries.zh: 致仕：告老辞官、自愿退职
entries.en: to retire from office; to resign a post of one's own accord

entries.zh: 传后：把家业、名声传给后世
entries.en: to hand down to those who come after
entries.notes: R 栏末字两读并存，不影响「后」义

entries.zh: 传后代：把产业家声传给子孙后代
entries.en: to hand down to one's descendants
entries.notes: M 栏末字 [疑]，R 栏音合「代」

entries.zh: 传子及孙：把家业传给儿子与孙辈
entries.en: to leave (one's estate) to sons and grandsons

entries.zh: 让畔：让出田界（典出「耕者让畔」，喻以田产相让）
entries.en: to yield the ridge between fields; (alluding to the classic 'tillers yield the ridges') to give up sown land
entries.notes: 西语 por todo por fiar 难通、疑讹，M 栏第二字 T99 污损，释义据汉字典故

entries.zh: 息事：平息事端、让事情了结
entries.en: to let a matter drop; to settle a quarrel and have done with it
entries.notes: M、R 两栏音写对「息」均不协，唯汉字义与「任其了结」相合

entries.zh: 据伊（疑当作「归伊」）：由他、任他自便
entries.en: to leave it to him; to let him have his way
entries.notes: 「拠」为「據」俗体（[疑:拠/捉]），音近「歸」，M、R 声母互异

entries.zh: 在人：随人、由人自定（闽语「在人」即任凭他人）
entries.en: to leave it to people; to be up to them

entries.zh: 任伊：任他自便、由他去
entries.en: to let him be; to leave him to his own will
